BufferedContainer<T>

A container that renders its children to an internal framebuffer, and then blits the framebuffer to the screen, instead of directly rendering the children to the screen. This allows otherwise impossible effects to be applied to the appearance of the container at the cost of performance. Such effects include uniform fading of children, blur, and other post-processing effects.

BufferedContainer

A container that renders its children to an internal framebuffer, and then blits the framebuffer to the screen, instead of directly rendering the children to the screen. This allows otherwise impossible effects to be applied to the appearance of the container at the cost of performance. Such effects include uniform fading of children, blur, and other post-processing effects. If all children are of a specific non-osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable type, use the generic version osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.BufferedContainer`1.

CompositeComponent

An updateable component that can be inserted into the draw hierarchy and has self-managed child components. This is currently used as a marker for cases where nothing more than load, update, lifetime support and hierarchy presence are required. Eventually this will be fleshed out (and the inheritance will be reversed to Drawable : Component).

CompositeDrawable

A drawable consisting of a composite of child drawables which are managed by the composite object itself. Transformations applied to a osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable are also applied to its children. Additionally, osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawables support various effects, such as masking, edge effect, padding, and automatic sizing depending on their children.

CompositeDrawable.CompositeDrawableDrawNode

A draw node responsible for rendering a osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable and the osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNodes of its children.

Container<T>

A drawable which can have children added to it. Transformations applied to a container are also applied to its children. Additionally, containers support various effects, such as masking, edge effect, padding, and automatic sizing depending on their children.

Container

A drawable which can have children added to it. Transformations applied to a container are also applied to its children. Additionally, containers support various effects, such as masking, edge effect, padding, and automatic sizing depending on their children. If all children are of a specific non-osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable type, use the generic version osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.

DelayedLoadWrapper

A container which asynchronously loads specified content. Has the ability to delay the loading until it has been visible on-screen for a specified duration. In order to benefit from delayed load, we must be inside a osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1.

DrawSizePreservingFillContainer

A osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container filling its parent while preserving a given target osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.DrawSize according to a osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.DrawSizePreservationStrategy. This is useful, for example, to automatically scale the user interface according to the window resolution, or to provide automatic HiDPI display support.

FillFlowContainer<T>

A osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.FlowContainer`1 that fills space by arranging its children next to each other. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children can be arranged horizontally, vertically, and in a combined fashion, which is controlled by osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.FillFlowContainer`1.Direction. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children are arranged from left-to-right if their osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Anchor is to the left or centered horizontally. They are arranged from right-to-left otherwise. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children are arranged from top-to-bottom if their osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Anchor is to the top or centered vertically. They are arranged from bottom-to-top otherwise.

FillFlowContainer

A osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.FlowContainer`1 that fills space by arranging its children next to each other. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children can be arranged horizontally, vertically, and in a combined fashion, which is controlled by osu.Framework.Graphics.Direction. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children are arranged from left-to-right if their osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Anchor is to the left or centered horizontally. They are arranged from right-to-left otherwise. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children are arranged from top-to-bottom if their osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Anchor is to the top or centered vertically. They are arranged from bottom-to-top otherwise. If non-osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawableosu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children are desired, use osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.FillFlowContainer`1.

LifetimeManagementContainer

This container is optimized for when number of alive children is significantly smaller than number of all children. Specifically, the time complexity of osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Update should be closer to O(number of alive children + 1) rather than O(number of all children + 1) for typical frames.

SafeAreaContainer

An osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container that can also apply a padding based on the safe areas of the nearest cached osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.SafeAreaDefiningContainer. Padding will only be applied if the contents of this container would otherwise intersect the safe area margins relative to the associated target container.

SafeAreaDefiningContainer

A osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container that is automatically cached and provides a osu.Framework.Bindables.BindableSafeArea representing the desired safe area margins. Should be used in conjunction with child osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.SafeAreaContainers. The root of the scenegraph contains an instance of this container, with osu.Framework.Bindables.BindableSafeArea automatically bound to the host osu.Framework.Platform.IWindow's osu.Framework.Platform.IWindow.SafeAreaPadding.

SearchContainer<T>

A container which automatically filters osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.IFilterable children based on a search term. Re-filtering will only be performed when the osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.SearchContainer`1.SearchTerm changes, or the layout of the container is invalidated.

VirtualisedListContainer<TData, TDrawable>

This class is an alternative to combined osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1 / osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.FlowContainer`1 usage for large lists (think thousands of items). This class efficiently handles collection change events, as well as applies pooling to only allocate drawables for what is actually visible on screen. The trade-off is that every row has to have an estimated or fixed height so that layout can be estimated cheaply pre-emptively.

Am osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.IFilterable that additionally allows specifying whether the item can be shown based on additional criteria.
